'''Grovo''' was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Grovo appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Grovo and Axkva Min were added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref> Grovo was removed from the game when Axkva Min was included in the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|eponymous]] "[[W:c:swg:Category:Heroic_instances|Heroic Encounter]],"<ref name="SWG:AM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=heroic|Axkva Min}}</ref> upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref> Grovo was in fact replaced by another rancor named [[Gorvo]].<ref name="SWG:AM" />
